newsitem.title: USA: British woman caught "eloping" with 14-yr old boy.
newsitem.headline: British woman caught "eloping" with 14-yr old boy.

text.p: A British woman has been charged with "lewd and lascivious behaviour" after she was caught with her neighbour's 14-year-old son in an apparent elopement from England to the Florida Keys, police said on Friday.
Tracey Lee Whalin, 33, from Nottingham, was charged in a Monroe County court on Thursday.
When police knocked on the door of a condominium in Tavernier in the Keys, 14-year-old Sean Kinsella opened up and said: "She's not decent right now."

Sean is the soccer-playing best friend of Whalin's son, Ross. British police had been seeking the couple since Whalin allegedly left her husband, took $5,000 out of the bank and drove off with Sean under the pretense of taking him to school.
They are believed to have flown to Orlando and visited Disney World before taking a bus to the Keys, police said.

Authorities say Sean told them the couple were romantically involved but refused to say if they had a physical relationship. He had called his mother from Tavernier and said he was still in England and all was well.
Whelan is in custody pending bail of $175,000. She will appear in court again on Aug. 12.
